research.finding: Long-serving board chair Andreas von Blottnitz and director Janet Kerr retired effective 2026-06-29; CEO Shane Trigg took the chairman role and a new lead independent director was created.
research.why_it_matters: CEO and chair combining reduces board independence at the same moment two long-tenured directors left.

research.finding: CEO compensation agreement amended 2026-04-09, increasing salary, bonus and equity awards.
research.quote: increasing salary, bonus, and equity awards
research.why_it_matters: Retention economics for the CEO were reset shortly before the governance change.

research.finding: PMS-native AI shipped aggressively across all four incumbents in 2024-25 (Yardi Chat IQ, Entrata ELI+, AppFolio Realm-X, RealPage Lea); by 2026 operators treat it as a complement rather than a replacement.
research.quote: highly resistant to disruption over the years
research.why_it_matters: AI parity across incumbents means it is table stakes, not a moat - and new entrants are raising capital against them.

research.finding: Category leadership claims for this product come from the vendor's own blog and are not independent.
research.why_it_matters: Marked so it cannot be mistaken for third-party validation.

research.finding: National asking rent growth decelerated to 0.1% year over year, the weakest pace since Q4 2010.
research.quote: decelerated to just 0.1% year-over-year, the weakest pace since
research.why_it_matters: Customers price software against rent roll; flat rents compress what they will pay per unit.

research.finding: Property insurance premiums rising 15-30% annually in Florida, Texas and Louisiana, squeezing operator margins while rent growth stalls.
research.why_it_matters: The customer base is in a margin squeeze, which is where software budgets get cut first.

research.finding: The property management acquisition market reopened in 2026 on improved lending; single-family-rental managers are consolidating at premium EBITDA multiples.
research.quote: one of the strongest opportunities owners have seen in years
research.why_it_matters: Customer consolidation arrives as churn only after two customers become one contract - it is invisible in retention until it lands.

assumptions_without_research.assumption: The recurring revenue percentage of 94% will remain stable and support the projected growth trajectory.

assumptions_without_research.assumption: The year-over-year growth rate of 16% is sustainable and will not accelerate beyond the historical baseline.
